request.style: English, jazz, male baritone voice, solo with soft choir backing, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, double bass, smooth and contemplative mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Wide is the gate and broad is the road
It leads to destruction, many go through
The path is easy to follow
But the end brings only loss

[Chorus]
Enter through the narrow gate
Where the road is hard and steep
Few find the way to life
Keep your watch and stay alert

[Verse]
Beware of false prophets near
Sheep's clothing hides the wolf
Look at the fruit they bear
To know if they are true

[Chorus]
Enter through the narrow gate
Where the road is hard and steep
Few find the way to life
Keep your watch and stay alert

[Bridge]
Good trees bring good fruit to see
Rotten trees give bad fruit
Recognize them by their ways
Do not be deceived by looks

[Outro]
The narrow road leads to life
Few find it, but it waits
Enter through the narrow gate
